statements.t: The Company plans to release its definitive third quarter financial results the week of November 9, 2026.

The Company expects its definitive third quarter financial results to reflect continued momentum in e-commerce, including higher subscription revenue, which is expanding the recurring component of SenesTech’s revenue base, as well as increasing traction in B2B.

“This is another quarter demonstrating progress on the plans and strategies we have previously announced, and our full third quarter financial results are expected to reflect that progress across the commercial model we have been building.

With many of the investments and transition costs incurred earlier in the year increasingly behind us, coupled with strong revenue growth and improved unit economics, we expect continued, improved metrics going forward,” Edell concluded.
The Company's Evolve® and ContraPest® fertility control solutions, along with its assessment and monitoring services, target reproduction to help reduce rodent populations.

These include statements regarding the Company’s expected third quarter 2026 revenue, anticipated momentum in e-commerce and increasing traction in B2B, expected progress across the Company’s commercial model, and anticipated continued, improved metrics going forward.
